name: code-agent-monitor-desktop
description: Native macOS desktop shell for Code Agent Monitor.
author: Michael Buluma <1452922+buluma@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.package: rm -rf release && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dmg:arm64: rm -rf release && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never --config.dmg.title='Code Agent Monitor (Apple Silicon)'
scripts.dmg:x64: rm -rf release && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never --config.dmg.title='Code Agent Monitor (Intel)'
scripts.dmg:universal: rm -rf release && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never --config.dmg.title='Code Agent Monitor (Universal)'
